'''Giant masked lovebirds''' are [[giant animal]] counterparts of regular [[masked lovebird]]s, who spawn in any [[savage]] [[tropical]] [[forest]]. Unlike their basal equivalents, giant cockatiels are larger than a [[grizzly bear]]. They appear in clusters of 5-10 individuals, and are not benign so may defend themselves if provoked.

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] giant masked lovebirds for their ''loving nature''.
